name: LLM / Agent Action Surface (conditional — when system includes LLM agent)
checks: Action descriptions accurately describe handler behavior (description = contract surface for LLM router)
Tool parameter schemas (name, type, enum) match handler parsing
System prompt does not claim capabilities the system doesn't have
System prompt does not omit capabilities the system does have
Tool descriptions do not embed example values that LLM could parrot as real data
Representative natural language inputs map to correct tool selection
Agent correctly refuses unsupported requests (no hallucinated actions)
Action surface exposure/pruning rules respected (no actions exposed that should be hidden)
Approval/side-effect boundaries correctly enforce permission gates
Tests cover: tool description accuracy, parameter schema consistency, routing correctness

checks.check: Runtime coverage questions per path type: request/response (did it arrive, where did it fail, why slow), background (did it start, did it duplicate, which step), stateful (which truth owner changed, where is the evidence), external (provider or local failure).

anti_patterns: Tool descriptions treated as code comments (not tested or maintained)
System prompt lists capabilities that don't exist
Only English input tested when users speak other languages
Tool registry changed but system prompt not updated
Agent suggests actions that aren't available
why: Review guidance, not an enforced checker or proof of review completion. Apply each question to this repo’s actual scope and architecture; state when it does not apply. Source names and R-/PL- identifiers are historical attribution, not required files in the adopter. Historical measurements below describe the recorded experiment, not a new measurement.
